conclusion: The region's start tick is not a label on an identity. It is the only bridge between what the Event List reports (absolute bar/beat/division/tick) and what a caller asks for (region-relative), and the bridge is one subtraction. Remove the region origin and region-relative note verification cannot be COMPUTED — not merely cannot be identified, which is what the contract change had been treated as. Since the region surface supplies no exact start tick, the honest outcome is an explicit unavailable result, and the API already has the shape for it.
limits: This is a reading of the source, not of Logic. It establishes what the code requires, not what Logic could be made to report.
It says nothing about whether a live signature-and-tempo map read could supply the origin. ADR-016 reads the tempo map; no live signature-map reader was looked for here.
Every region observed so far starts on a bar boundary and `startBar` is an Int, but bar-granular readings cannot establish that a region's true start is exactly on that boundary.
One unresolved call site is not an inventory. Compilation succeeding elsewhere does not establish that the other migrated call sites kept their meaning.
